name: Compromise amendment
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 12. Stresses that resilient healthcare systems are a cornerstone of social cohesion and economic stability; calls for the 2027 budget to support strong and sustainable public health systems, and promote equitable access to quality healthcare services across all regions; is concerned about the rapidly worsening mental health situation in Europe, especially among young people; calls on the Commission to prioritise mental health actions in the 2027 budget; recalls that the ESF+ should solely finance healthcare services, as defined in Article 3(a) of Directive 2011/24/EU1a; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Directive 2011/24/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 March 2011 on the application of patients’ rights in cross-border healthcare (OJ L 88, 4.4.2011, p. 45, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2011/24/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2011/24/oj)).
